name: 1950s brick apartment flat
description: Two-room single-storey template of a 1950s brick-built apartment flat: solid 225 mm brick walls, small windows (1.6 and 1.2 m2) and 0.5 ach design infiltration.
notes: Illustrative template derived from the synthetic dwelling fixture (identical RunPeriod, schedules and outputs); one exposed facade per room, box geometry, TM59-style occupancy and gains, operable openings via ZoneVentilation:WindandStackOpenArea.

name: 2005 terrace house
description: Three-room single-storey template of a 2005 terraced house: insulated masonry cavity walls, medium glazing (1.8-2.4 m2 per room) and 0.4 ach design infiltration.
notes: Illustrative template derived from the synthetic dwelling fixture (identical RunPeriod, schedules and outputs); living room, kitchen (with cooking-level equipment gains) and bedroom zones, box geometry, operable openings via ZoneVentilation:WindandStackOpenArea.

name: New-build semi-detached (2020s)
description: Two-room single-storey template of a 2020s semi-detached new build: heavily insulated cavity walls, large glazing (4.5 m2 living window, second bedroom window on an east facet) and 0.25 ach design infiltration.
notes: Illustrative template derived from the synthetic dwelling fixture (identical RunPeriod, schedules and outputs); bedroom zone has two exposed facets (north and east), box geometry, operable openings via ZoneVentilation:WindandStackOpenArea.
